scraped.scraped_description: Your single source for UK Government, Parliamentary and Legislative information

name: Parallel Parliament
tagline: A comprehensive platform for tracking UK parliamentary legislation, debates, and legislative processes with live transcripts and bill amendment tracking.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

academic_citations.title: The European Parliament as a discourse community: its role in comparable analyses of data drawn from parallel interpreting corpora
Studying Directionality in Simultaneous Interpreting through an Electronic Corpus: EPIC (European Parliament Interpreting Corpus)

jurisdictional_scope: United Kingdom Parliament (House of Commons and House of Lords)
political_relevance_summary: Parallel Parliament addresses gaps in democratic participation by providing tools or platforms that enable citizens and communities to engage more directly in governance and decision-making processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: Parallel Parliament directly enables organizing by providing tools for collective action, campaigning, or community mobilization.

generalizability_notes: Limited generalizability. Parallel Parliament is proprietary and designed for UK-specific contexts. The concept could inspire similar efforts elsewhere but direct replication is not feasible.
